# Wallet and billing

Prepaid wallet balances and ledger, sandbox credits, top-ups (card, manual bank transfer), auto top-up, saved payment methods and invoices. For developers who need to read spend or automate funding.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

### POST /v1/wallet/topups/manual

**Submit a private manual bank-transfer proof**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner, admin or finance browser session with enabled two-factor authentication. Live environment only. Creates awaiting_approval without crediting funds. Idempotency includes normalized amount, currency, filename and proof hash.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |

**Request body** (`multipart/form-data`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | string | yes |  | Positive decimal with at most two fractional digits. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `3`, maxLength `3`. |
| `file` | string (binary) | yes |  | PDF/PNG/JPEG proof |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Successful response. | `application/json`: [ManualTopupSubmission](schemas.md#manualtopupsubmission) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `409` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `413` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `422` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/wallet/topups/manual" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-e6e064f7-6088-4228-9e2c-ba20c42ad730' \
  -F 'amount=1000.00' \
  -F 'currency=KES' \
  -F 'file=@transfer-proof.png;type=image/png'
```

Response `422` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Unprocessable Entity",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "Manual transfers require live environment."
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Live environment only. The docs stack has no live workspace (going live needs a verified email, which needs email delivery, disabled here), so only the sandbox refusal is shown.

### PUT /v1/wallet/auto-topup

**Configure saved-card auto-topup**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Browser session only, owner/admin/finance membership, explicit workspace and live environment. Owners and finance members of live workspaces must have TOTP enabled. Select a usable verified card authorization belonging to the workspace and wallet currency. If payment_method_id is omitted, the current usable selection or exactly one eligible method is selected. Repeated identical PUTs do not duplicate audit/events. This endpoint configures consent and performs no external charge.

**Auth:** Not declared in the contract (the operation has no `security` entry and the spec has no global default). See the description for what the handler requires.

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |  |
| `threshold` | string or number | no |  | Required when enabled, nonnegative decimal with at most two fractional digits. |
| `amount` | string or number | no |  | Required when enabled, positive decimal with at most two fractional digits. |
| `channel` | string | no |  | One of: `card`. |
| `currency` | string | no |  | Must match the workspace currency if supplied |
| `payment_method_id` | string (uuid) | no |  |  |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Successful response. | `application/json`: [AutoTopupSettings](schemas.md#autotopupsettings) |
| `400` | Invalid settings or missing explicit workspace/environment | No body |
| `401` | Browser session required | No body |
| `403` | Role or live TOTP policy denied | No body |
| `422` | Sandbox mutation, currency mismatch or no usable selected authorization | No body |
| `503` | Settings unavailable | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X PUT "$OPENSMS_API/v1/wallet/auto-topup" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

Response `422` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Unprocessable Entity",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "Auto-topup settings require the live environment."
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Live environment only. The docs stack has no live workspace (going live needs a verified email, which needs email delivery, disabled here), so only the sandbox refusal is shown.

### POST /v1/wallet/sandbox-credits

**Add simulated sandbox practice credits**

Operation ID: `addSandboxWalletCredit`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner, admin, or finance browser session only. Requires X-Environment sandbox. Adds simulated credit to the selected sandbox wallet without creating a payment or contacting a provider. Amount must be 0.01 to 10,000.00, with a 10,000.00 total per workspace UTC day and 100,000.00 maximum resulting available balance. Sandbox available balances reset to 10,000.00 daily. Idempotency-Key is unique across the workspace; identical retries return the original posting, changed requests return 409. The credit, audit record, and wallet event are committed together.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `200`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | string | yes |  | Example: `1000.00`. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  | Example: `KES`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Simulated credit posted, or an identical request replayed. | `application/json`: [SandboxWalletCredit](schemas.md#sandboxwalletcredit) |
| `400` | Invalid JSON, selection, currency or idempotency key. | No body |
| `401` | Browser session missing or invalid. | No body |
| `403` | Workspace membership or role missing. | No body |
| `404` | Sandbox wallet currency not found. | No body |
| `409` | Idempotency key reused with a different request. | No body |
| `422` | Live environment selected or sandbox credit limit exceeded. | No body |
| `503` | Sandbox credit temporarily unavailable. | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/wallet/sandbox-credits" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-ca592936-d266-4ad9-a7ee-1f385357fd32' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"amount":"500","currency":"KES"}'
```

Response `201` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "wallet_id": "54c8b9a0-f37b-4178-9c9f-e070a0eb2aba",
  "ledger_id": "183",
  "amount": "500.00",
  "currency": "KES",
  "balance": "10500.000000",
  "environment": "sandbox",
  "status": "credited",
  "simulated": true
}
```

### POST /v1/wallet/topups

**Initialize a live wallet payment**

Operation ID: `initializeWalletTopup`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Owner, admin and finance sessions may initialize payments. API keys require wallet:topup (legacy wallet:write also accepted). The payer email must belong to a verified active workspace member; for browser sessions it must be the signed-in user's email. Sandbox payment initialization is rejected without contacting a provider. Initialization never credits a wallet; verified payment confirmation does. Idempotency-Key is scoped to workspace and environment; an exact replay returns the stored response, a changed payload returns 409, and an unresolved claim returns 409 until reconciliation. Do not switch to a new key after an uncertain provider outcome.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`), or API key (any scope).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `255`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | string | yes |  | Example: `10.00`. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  | Example: `KES`. |
| `channel` | string | yes |  | One of: `card`, `mobile_money`, `bank_transfer`. |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | Successful response. | `application/json`: [WalletTopupInitialization](schemas.md#wallettopupinitialization) |
| `400` | Invalid request or session selection. | No body |
| `401` | Invalid or expired credential. | No body |
| `403` | Required role or scope missing. | No body |
| `404` | Currency wallet not found. | No body |
| `422` | Sandbox wallets cannot use payment providers. | No body |
| `502` | Provider initialization failed. | No body |
| `503` | Payment provider not configured. | No body |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/wallet/topups" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-6801974c-6ec5-4f2a-98bf-509da5544a54' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"amount":"1000","currency":"KES","channel":"card"}'
```

Response `422` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Unprocessable Entity",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "sandbox wallets cannot use payment providers"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Top-ups go through Paystack in the live environment. Payments are disabled on the docs stack and the workspace is sandbox-only, so only the refusal is shown.

### GET /v1/invoices/{id}

**Read an existing invoice**

Operation ID: `getCustomerInvoice`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Browser session plus explicit workspace/environment required. Owner/admin/finance only. Money remains decimal strings, VAT percentage is numeric, missing PDF is null.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | yes |  | One of: `live`, `sandbox`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Existing invoice, no document generation or settlement implied | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Why this is not the success path: Invoices are issued for live spend only, so none exist locally and an unknown ID is used.
